name: p3-typed-client
cmd: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$PWD; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; trap 'rm -rf "$OUT/project/.lake"' EXIT; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun scripts/gen-lean-library.ts > "$OUT/library-gen.log" 2>&1; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < research/bapa/P3-TYPED-CLIENT-COMMIT.txt > "$OUT/commitlint.log" 2>&1; bun research/bapa/p3-client-typed.ts client-capture client-lean/Proofs.lean "$OUT/project" > "$OUT/emission.log" 2>&1; cd "$OUT/project"; lake build > "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; lake env lean BapaProof.lean >> "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/scripts/lean-gate/gate.ts" "$OUT/lean.log" BapaProof.lean TypedBoundControls.lean > "$OUT/axioms.log" 2>&1; printf '%s\n' 'Lean checked: typed family, preserved tree shapes, old-bound mutant, source inclusion, public existential theorem' > "$OUT/CHECKED.txt"
